issue.title: Zero-weight (-w 0) wait monitors bucket as Running and inflate the Agents tab running count

task_type_fields.impact: The running count and Running group overstate live work by every pure wait: CI watches, release watches, sleeps, and bead/core pollers (100+ such monitors in the last two weeks). The header disagrees with the capacity meter, and "WAITING ..." labels appear under the Running heading, which reads as a bug to the user. Fixing it is not a one-liner. Moving these rows to Waiting changes clan label mirroring: `clan_status_source_index` in src/sase/agent/status_buckets.py mirrors only a lone Running/Starting member, so a clan would degrade from "WAITING CORE" to a bare "WAITING". It also needs an audit of every consumer of the in-flight buckets (IN_FLIGHT_STATUS_BUCKETS, agent_row_is_in_flight, the Waiting-group time column, `sase agent list`, the mobile summary) and a check of the Rust-core boundary for shared bucket semantics.
task_type_fields.repro:
Observed 2026-10-27 on athena (TUI screenshot ~/tmp/screenshots/20261027_102338.png): the Agents tab header read "7 running" and the Running group held `sase (WAITING CORE)` (sase-1oe.4) and `sase (WAITING CUTOVER)` (sase-1n6.10), while the capacity meter read "athena cap 5/8".

Both rows are monitor members started with `-w 0`: their agent_meta.json records `queue_weight: 0.0` and `monitor_queue_weight_overridden: true`. One polls `tools/ratchet_core_pin --check` and the other polls `sase bead read` every 5 minutes. Neither holds runner capacity.

Repro: start any pure wait with `sase monitor start -w 0 -s 'SLEEPING FOR 600s' -S 'SLEPT FOR 600s' -- sleep 600` inside an agent, then
- `sase monitor list --json` reports `"status_bucket": "Running"` for it, and
- the Agents tab files the agent (or its clan) under Running and counts it in the header's running total.

Cause: `MonitorRecord.status_bucket` (src/sase/monitor/models.py) returns "Running" for every non-terminal monitor, and `monitor_state_bucket` (src/sase/monitor_state.py, written into member meta by monitor/supervise.py, reconcile.py, proc_adapter.py) maps state "running" to "Running". Neither consults the monitor's zero queue weight, which is recorded only in the member's agent meta, not on the monitor record.

issue.creation_reason: Found while explaining WAITING CORE / WAITING CUTOVER rows in the Running group; split out of the monitor-label plan because it changes shared status-bucket semantics.
